description: This file defines a utility class `ContactViewBinder` that provides a static method to bind a `Contact` object to an Android `TextView` by setting its text and icon.

classes.name: ContactViewBinder
classes.description: A utility class with a static method to bind a Contact to a TextView.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Contact object to a TextView, setting its text to the contact's name and its icon drawable.
